title: psf/requests#5688: Upgrade to chardet 4.x

payload.pr_body: I just released [chardet 4.0.0](https://github.com/chardet/chardet/releases/tag/4.0.0) today, and it's faster and fully backward compatible with chardet 3.x (as long as you aren't mucking around in the models it uses under-the-hood directly). The next major release will be Python 3.6+, but seeing as it took me three years to put out this one, that's unlikely to be soon.

text_excerpt:
Repo: psf/requests
PR #5688: Upgrade to chardet 4.x

PR body:
I just released [chardet 4.0.0](https://github.com/chardet/chardet/releases/tag/4.0.0) today, and it's faster and fully backward compatible with chardet 3.x (as long as you aren't mucking around in the models it uses under-the-hood directly). The next major release will be Python 3.6+, but seeing as it took me three years to put out this one, that's unlikely to be soon.
